capabilities: Copy configured properties from a linked source note into dependent notes
Pull property values when a link in a property is set or changed (forward sync)
Update all dependent notes via backlinks when a source property changes (reverse sync)
Configure sync rules with root folder, link property, and properties to copy
Run manual sync for the current file or all matching files from the command palette
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; on older builds reverse sync is skipped gracefully. Fresh installs start with no rules configured.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for a note to inherit property values from a note it links to, so users must duplicate frontmatter data by hand to use it in Bases, queries, and maps.

relations.evidence: A common setup with the official Maps plugin: each place lives in its own note under Locations/

summary: Property inheritance plugin that copies frontmatter values from a linked source note into dependent notes, with forward and reverse sync.
